materialFindings.title: The prospective rules-producer evidence does not bind the selected loaded assembly/type or transient discovery/cache lineage.
materialFindings.finding: The frozen build route can publish EditorBuild success after checking tool selection, constructor-produced vendor/module selection, native flags and the target receipt. Those checks do not identify the actual loaded project rules assembly and selected TargetRules CLR type, or capture the first-scan/cache/source-order lineage required by the scope. The generated rules DLL, PDB and source manifest are also outside the wrapper's retained-artifact inventory. Leaving these files in the stage is useful preservation, but does not bind them to the assembly/type actually used in the exited UBT process.

substantiveAssessment.area: Target construction, configuration and all-modules selection
substantiveAssessment.assessment: The dedicated target sets Editor, bBuildAllModules=false, V7, C++20 and enables E04ProfileProof. Applicable base configuration uses annotation-gated INI/XML/CLI assignments before derived construction; the derived false pin therefore matters. The read Windows finalization does not reverse that pin. The inherited ShouldIgnorePluginDependency implementation returns false and ReadOnlyTargetRules forwards the exact parent/reference arguments. Plugin-list defaults and applicable Editor getters were joined with selection rather than inferred solely from a base constructor. bCompileWithPluginSupport has an INI assignment path, but the compile-against-engine branch independently permits default plugin processing here. All conclusions remain conditional on the actual selected frozen target type.
substantiveAssessment.alternatives: Normal non-test construction was assessed. PreBuildSetup and AddAllValidModulesToTarget were read completely: the latter is a distinct bBuildAllModules alternative, not evidence that the normal selected target builds every catalog plugin.

substantiveAssessment.assessment: All 902 selected rows and all 1,561 Plugin-reference occurrences were interpreted. Every row has the four positively selected fields, and every ordered absentSelectorFields array exactly matches the complement of the 49 permitted selector fields. No duplicate plugin filename names were found. Five extension descriptors contain no module/dependency/platform additions; their merges do not enlarge this selection. One raw descriptor, USDPregen/Templates/PregenContent/PregenContent.uplugin, lies below an ancestor descriptor and is stopped by normal discovery. It is neither a current root nor a referenced destination.
dispositions: The conditional build set equals the 245-member conservative runtime set plus TcpMessaging and UdpMessaging. Their build membership does not defeat the separate runtime disable choices.
No applicable edge from the current selected build owners targets any of the six runtime-disabled plugins.

Four references differ in name casing from their destination filenames: DatasmithImporter/DataPrepEditor, AnimGen/TensorBoard, InterchangeAxF/InterchangeAxFAssets and AudioModulation/MetaSound. All four owners are outside the current selected build set. Their future runtime disposition is not inferred from UBT's case-insensitive matching.
Thirteen repeated module-name groups occur within individual plugins, not across different plugin owners. Their host/platform alternatives and already-loaded runtime checks were considered.

All 1,774 module occurrences were evaluated against the bound Editor/x64 conditions. Among selected build owners, 465 descriptor occurrences are compile-eligible and 19 are platform-filtered. These are descriptor eligibility results, not actual compiler actions or successful module builds.

Absent, false and empty platform lists were kept distinct. LowLevelNetTrace's explicit empty lists do not become universal platform support. Program-only selectors, architecture exclusions for arm64, unused requested-version behavior and unselected explicit-load routes remain conditioned.

substantiveAssessment.area: Discovery, source union and assembly production
substantiveAssessment.assessment: The frozen invocation names WarhammerClientE04AEditor, Win64, Development and the exact staged project. Its 33-member source membership contains three target files and four module-rule files, including the dedicated target. The complete normal route covers Source, extensions, additional roots, Mods, plugin Tests and Intermediate/Source; source ordering, parent/foreign-plugin guards, Rules/DirectoryItem/file/assembly caches, source-union compilation, Roslyn emission/load and target platform/group candidates were joined to this invocation. Current literal correspondence supports the intended route, while finding S_TARGET_RECEIPT-01 prevents claiming adequate prospective observation of the actual selected load/type and transient lineage.
substantiveAssessment.conditions: No-project, no-code, foreign-plugin and test routes are conditional alternatives, not the supplied normal invocation. Installed parent assembly, .NET/Roslyn, OS enumeration and library leaves are not asserted to have executed.

substantiveAssessment.assessment: BuildPlugins records build selection; Plugins records target overrides. They are not interchangeable enable roots. Receipt construction, sorted serialization, path variables, runtime parsing and receipt preference were assessed. The wrapper requires the exact stage receipt, target/platform/configuration, project and both launch paths, with the E04ProfileProof=true override and default-engine-plugin policy. Runtime project-receipt preference and engine fallback remain conditional on actual filesystem/parser/executable matching. The Read default expands variables; LaunchesCurrentExecutable defaults to testing both launch variants.

UE-CmdLineArgs insertion precedes project/plugin selection; the wrapper clears it and UE_ADDITIONAL_PLUGIN_PATHS and removes inherited E02 channels. The exact unattended Editor argv does not acquire commandlet semantics merely from the executable's Cmd suffix. Complete PreDefault/Default/PostDefault dispatch loads project modules before enabled non-explicit plugin modules and propagates normal phase failures to startup. E04ProfileParser and E04ProfileProbe use FDefaultModuleImpl. ExplicitlyLoaded plugins are excluded from normal dispatch.
substantiveAssessment.explicitLoading: Both applicable public and private maximum-phase defaults are ELoadingPhase::Max. Explicit mounting iterates phases below that maximum and skips None. Mount success/enabled/mounted state does not certify successful loading of every module: MountPluginFromExternalSource ignores the TryLoadModulesForPlugin boolean. PluginUtils, Fab installation, Pak virtualization, GDK DLC, GameFeatures policy/state-machine and low-level-test caller routes were assessed with their operation/platform/state/compile gates. Their source availability does not imply they run in this experiment.

substantiveAssessment.area: Compiler boundary, preservation and common requirements
substantiveAssessment.assessment: The External ModuleRules binds the acquired pin, staged project, same-run library/header bytes and concrete compiler/SDK paths. Parser/probe rules require NoPCHs; the build argv requires NoVFS. Editor exception enablement must be observed for both modules; the probe's local false does not establish A1G. Phase/source/settings/plugin/fixture preservation, predecessor linkage, private-job cleanup, six supervisor controls and retained-output checks were read as prospective contracts, not executed results. The rules-producer preservation gap is separately identified above.

errorsAndRecoveries: An initial full-contract display truncated. The complete local scope, common requirements, positive policies and relevant pure-contract fields were subsequently read/compared. No complete reading of the other nine scopes' duties is claimed.

Oversized source displays truncated. BODY054/055/057 were reread in complete recoverable portions; BODY094's affected 3105..3167 interval was reread. Mandatory source coverage above excludes no lost interval.

Several oversized selected-metadata displays truncated. Complete ordered indexes, presence-aware comparisons and uncapped all-entry relationship traversals replaced those displays. Counts alone were not used as semantic selector evidence.

A policy query incorrectly used records instead of selectedRecords and stopped. It was corrected before dependent record output. An invalid PowerShell -gt1 expression likewise stopped and was corrected.
An OrderedDictionary grouping produced a blank derived disposition label. Rebuilding the independently authored disposition objects recovered the exact 1551/7/3 counts.
A membership query emitted present=false with an empty derived query-result array. That array was not source JSON data; it was not interpreted as present null or an underlying empty array.

A whole-group equality attempt was overbroad and emitted only equality flags. Positive-field comparisons recovered identical selected identities/ranges; the 161 differences were selected source access markers present in record3 and absent in record4. These markers did not override BODY policy.
A comparison paired descriptorSelectorCatalog with record9 instead of record8. The corrected record8 descriptor comparison is exact.
Compiler reference records use relativePath rather than path. Joining all 167 against the exact declared referenceRoot recovered zero identity mismatches.

Literal hash-case differences and the acquisition root's explicit expectedOid=null initially appeared as comparison differences. They were recovered without converting them into source defects or inferred identities.
A slow ancestor-pair query yielded no relied-upon result. A complete parent-directory traversal recovered the single nested descriptor relationship.
